core.title: Contemporary Design Door Pull, Satin Nickel and Polished Chrome, FII-3400-US15/US26

text.description_html:
First Impressions 3400/12-US15/US26 Two Tone Contemporary Door Pull

Very Contemporary Two Tone door pull from First Impressions. The back flat portion of the pull is Satin Nickel and the front raised portion is Polished Chrome.

This contemporary designed pull is constructed of durable aluminum. It is a great choice for residential and commercial applications such as hotels or restaurants.

This contemporary door pull can be used in many applications such as:

  • Entrance and Patio Doors
  • Appliances, such as Refrigerators and Freezers
  • Glass Doors, such as on Showers or Storefronts
  • Furniture, such as Armoires
  • Just about anywhere a door pull is needed.

Specifications of First Impressions 3400 Contemporary Door Pull

  • Pull Width: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Finish: Satin Nickel (bottom) with Polished Chrome (top)
  • Non Rusting Aluminum
  • 12 Inches Total Length, 8 Inch Center to Center
